extraction_notes: Main-text performance data are in Figure 1 and the accompanying Results text. Approximate values marked '~' were read from plotted axes; exact printed numbers were used where the text provides them. Supporting Information was not provided in the prompt; therefore Figure S1 stability-time data and any SI tables/figures could not be extracted. Literature-comparison data mentioned as Table S1 were excluded.
